feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: The law releasing the Epstein files passed one year ago. What do his victims say?
entry.summary: It's been a year since the House passed the Epstein Files Transparency Act, forcing the Justice Department to release millions of files connected to the convicted sex offender. His victims speak out.

entry.title: Why the Nvidia scandal is a national security issue
entry.summary: The Nvidia scandal has spilled over into the Trump administration, which is now under intense scrutiny for how it allowed America's top AI chips to end up in China's hands.

entry.title: Unemployment is low, but frustrations are high for job seekers
entry.summary: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with Lindsay Ellis from The Wall Street Journal about why it's so hard for white collar workers to find jobs right now.

entry.title: The emotional layers of caregiving are at the heart 'Nanny Nanny'
entry.summary: NPR's Juana Summers speaks with K Chiucarello about their debut novel — Nanny Nanny. The main character is wrestling with past abuse and her desire to be a parent.

entry.title: Researchers are studying how large storms spread microplastics in the environment
entry.summary: In communities struck by Hurricane Helene, researchers have a rare chance to see how big storms increase the amount of microplastics in the environment.

entry.title: Democrats nominate Jeffries for speaker, prep investigations into Trump's orbit
entry.summary: Democrats gave the official nod to Hakeem Jeffries to be the next speaker of the House. Meanwhile, Democrats are ramping up their plans to investigate the Trump administration come January.

entry.title: After Nepal's epic flood, they're restoring their community ... and their lives
entry.summary: As the emergency response to the flood ends, aid workers turn to the hard work of rebuilding communities that lost everything. Many of those workers lost everything, too.

entry.title: After the White House pulls its nominee to lead the FDA, what's next for the agency?
entry.summary: On the eve of a key Senate vote, the White House withdrew Dr. Heidi Overton's nomination to run the Food and Drug Administration.

entry.title: Trump, Xi and Putin set to meet in historic summit
entry.summary: On the sidelines of a high-powered regional economic forum in China, Presidents Trump, Xi and Putin sit down for an unprecedented meeting with nuclear non-proliferation expected to be a focus.

entry.title: Democratic strategists think Montana House race could hold the secret to future wins
entry.summary: Montana is sending a Democrat to the U.S. House for the first time in three decades. Many in the party think Sam Forstag's campaign may be a playbook for how Democrats can win again in rural America.
